mentions.name: Gaussian Splatting support for Three.js (WebGPU)
mentions.description: Adds native Gaussian Splatting support to Three.js's WebGPU renderer, allowing Gaussian splat scenes to be rendered directly in the engine. The merged PR ships in the August Three.js release.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Been working on adding support for Gaussian Splats directly in ThreeJS specifically for WebGPU:

https://ben3d.ca/blog/gaussian-splatting-for-threejs

This PR was merged yesterday morning so the August ThreeJS release will have this new feature.
